description: Slop: adds the pitch instability of an analogue oscillator to a 1V/octave signal — mains hum, slow thermal drift and imperfect tracking

params.text: Depth of a 60Hz vibrato on the pitch, reaching 12 cents peak at full
Depth of the slow random detuning, which wanders with an average decay time of 60 seconds
Scales the pitch passing through; at the low end each octave played comes out 0.2 semitones flat
Reads the drift as a proportional detuning in cents or as a fixed offset in Hz, which pulls low notes further; marked cents and hz

inputs.text: The pitch to be detuned; with nothing patched the output carries the hum and the drift on their own

outputs.text: The input pitch with the tracking error, the hum and the drift added

notes: every channel of a polyphonic cable gets its own drift, while the hum is the same on all of them

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
